{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Navy blue silk crepe sheath dress, straight cut, midi length (knee to mid-calf), color #1e3a5f, fabric with a subtle fluid drape.
Silver drop earrings and a single delicate pendant necklace, metallic finish, color #c0c0c0, lightweight polished metal.
Black satin ankle boots with a moderate block heel, pointed toe, color #0a0a0a, smooth matte-finish satin material.

This outfit respects your wish to avoid a forced stylistic overhaul while honoring the formal evening context and your partner's tuxedo. The navy sheath dress offers a timeless, elegant silhouette in a noble silk crepe fabric that feels sophisticated yet comfortable for someone recovering from an illness, avoiding any tightness or restriction. By sticking to a monochromatic column effect with dark tones and minimal silver jewelry as requested, the look remains graceful and understated rather than overly loud or distracting. The choice of satin ankle boots provides stability and ease of movement without compromising the formal atmosphere of the charity gala in an upscale restaurant."}
